title: Reticular Chemistry
description: Crystals designed as nets: nodes and struts chosen to leave pores of exactly the size wanted. Unlocks the Framework Assembler and the MOF Gas Storage Cell.

puzzle.goal: A framework's nodes are joined by linkers of length L; the node itself takes up a width w. Write the pore p left between two struts, if it scales by s.
puzzle.name: Net geometry
puzzle.ask: Find p in ångströms for s = @{s}, L = @{L} Å and w = @{w} Å.
puzzle.method: The struts set the cell; what the nodes take up comes off it.
